title: Revolutionary dual nanofiller embedded nanofiltration membranes: fabricated CQDs and PMO-PPD modified membranes for experimental design optimization of simultaneous removal of Pb(II), MO, and NaCl from wastewater
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,435-448
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00871E, Paper
Farzad Mehrjo, Afsaneh Shahbazi
This study introduces a revolutionary nanofiltration membrane capable of significantly enhancing the removal of Pb(II), MO, and NaCl from industrial wastewater.
